test-integration.description: Run the reference nginx configuration (#482, ADR-019 Decisions 1, 5 and 8), unchanged, in front of a stub auth server and a stub ceremony app, and check each rule: host routing and 421, /ui/* to the ceremony app on the normalised path, 404 for path variants, Cookie stripping, the /ui/* response headers, X-Forwarded-* overwriting, and 404 for /metrics and /internal/*. Requires a running Docker daemon and openssl. CI's `integration` job runs it when this project is affected.
